_comment: C0-13 microsoft-designer bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（microsoft-copilot/adobe-firefly），related 写 2 条。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Models are routed on Microsoft's side (the DALL·E-family image line merged into the Bing/Copilot ecosystem narrative; the current concrete model tiers not verified item by item); users pick features, not bare models.
axes.runtime: Web (designer.microsoft.com) + image capabilities embedded in Bing/Copilot/Office apps; generation processed on Microsoft's cloud.
axes.local_files: Works stored on the Microsoft account side (integration surfaces with the OneDrive/Office ecosystem); no models run locally.
axes.background: Generation is instant; no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified); image capabilities embedded in Office are invoked in the host app's foreground.
axes.tools: The product includes text-to-image, image editing (background removal etc.), design templates (social graphics/posters), image-to-video-style capability lines (as seen in site navigation); it overlaps with Canva-style template design but AI generation is the main axis (included in this category; Canva is not — see inventory).
axes.context: Organized by projects (integration surfaces with the OneDrive/Office ecosystem exist; details not verified item by item); cross-session memory — no official statement verified.
axes.permissions: Microsoft account system; the training-use switch sits in Microsoft's privacy dashboard (same dashboard line as Copilot), path and default state not verified item by item; commercial rights vary by subscription tier (D9: prices not collected).
axes.fit: Fits: lightweight design output for Microsoft-ecosystem users (social-graphic/poster templates + AI generation), starting free. Does not fit: wanting model self-selection, open weights, or leaving the Microsoft account.

runs:
